categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor equipment including front-end semiconductor cleaning equipment, electroplating equipment, vertical furnace tube series, coating and developing track equipment, plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) equipment, stress-free polishing equipment, back-end advanced packaging equipment, and silicon material substrate manufacturing process equipment. It provides customized, high-performance, and low-consumption process solutions to semiconductor manufacturers to improve production efficiency and product yield while reducing costs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary SAPS and TEBO megasonic cleaning technologies for uniform and damage-free wafer cleaning, multi-anode localized electroplating technology for copper interconnects, stress-free polishing combining electrochemical polishing with CMP, and advanced PECVD with self-developed chambers and gas distribution. The company also develops vertical furnace tube equipment, coating and developing track systems, and advanced packaging wet process equipment, with a strong focus on innovation and intellectual property protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor manufacturers including domestic giants like Yangtze Memory Technologies, Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC), Hefei Changxin, SK Hynix, Huahong Group, Tongfu Microelectronics, and Hejing Technology. The company serves the integrated circuit manufacturing industry, covering logic chips, DRAM, 3D NAND, advanced packaging, and compound semiconductors, addressing markets in China, Taiwan, Korea, and the US.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Wuxi, Beijing, Chengdu, Hong Kong, Korea, and California. Its sales and service network covers China mainland, Taiwan, Korea, and the United States, with increasing efforts to expand global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a semiconductor equipment manufacturer. It designs and produces critical manufacturing equipment used by semiconductor fabs and packaging facilities, and also manages procurement of key components through subsidiaries and partnerships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in semiconductor cleaning, electroplating, and packaging equipment technologies, expanding product platforms, and enhancing global customer base. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on advanced nodes (28nm and below), 3D NAND, DRAM, advanced packaging, and compound semiconductors. It also emphasizes green manufacturing and energy-saving technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related spare parts. The company follows a direct sales model without distributors, securing orders via direct negotiations, agency promotion, and bidding. It also derives income from after-sales services and customized process solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the top five semiconductor equipment suppliers in China, with a 23% market share in China’s cleaning equipment sector and a 6.6% global share, ranking fifth worldwide. It competes with international giants such as DNS, Tokyo Electron (TEL), LAM Research, and SEMES, especially in cleaning equipment. It differentiates itself through proprietary technologies and localized customer support.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 5.62 billion, a 44.48% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.15 billion, up 26.65%. Total assets reached RMB 12.13 billion, growing 24.35%, with net assets of RMB 7.67 billion, up 18.69%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding orders and market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology differentiation through proprietary cleaning technologies (SAPS and TEBO), multi-anode electroplating, and stress-free polishing, enabling superior wafer cleaning uniformity, damage-free processing, and cost reduction. Its products offer high performance, customization, and energy efficiency, meeting advanced semiconductor manufacturing requirements and supporting customers’ yield improvement and cost control.
